why_h: Why Free Here Really Means Free
why_p: Paid chart sites need your fee because your data sits on their server, in their account system, behind their checkout. Loona Astrology Tools is built the opposite way — the code comes to your device and does the work there. No server costs, no accounts, nothing to lock behind a paywall. Occasional advertising keeps the site running, and in return the full chart is free forever.

faq1_q: Is this birth chart calculator really free?
faq1_a: Yes, completely. The full chart — Big Three, all planet positions, houses and the chart wheel — is calculated in your browser at no cost. There is no premium version and no paywall.
faq2_q: Do I need to create an account or sign up?
faq2_a: No. There is no account system at all. Enter your birth details and your chart appears. Nothing you type is sent to us or stored anywhere.
faq3_q: What if I do not know my birth time?
faq3_a: Tick “Birth time unknown” and the calculator uses 12:00 (noon) local time. Your Sun and planet signs are still calculated, but the Rising sign and houses depend on the exact time of day, so they are hidden and marked as unavailable.
faq4_q: Which house system do you use?
faq4_a: Equal House: the Ascendant is the cusp of the 1st house and each following house starts 30 degrees later. It is simple, transparent and labelled on every result. It is not Placidus.
faq5_a: Positions are calculated in your browser with a compact astronomy method. A planet within about 3° of a sign boundary may fall in the neighbouring sign in some professional ephemerides. Most bodies are accurate to well under a degree; the slowest outer planets can differ by up to about 3 degrees in the worst cases, so treat cusp cases with care.
faq6_q: Where does my birth data go?
faq6_a: Nowhere. Everything runs 100% in your browser. Your birth date, time and place are never uploaded to us or anyone else. See the Privacy Policy for the full explanation, including the standard analytics cookies this site uses.

about_inshort: In short: Loona Astrology Tools exists so anyone can calculate a complete, honest birth chart free — no sign-up, no paywall at the results, and birth data that never leaves the visitor's own device.
about_body:
Why We Built This

Search for a free birth chart and you will find the same pattern again and again: enter your birth details, see a teaser — then hit a paywall or a sign-up wall before you can read your own chart. Loona Astrology Tools is the opposite deal. You enter your birth date, time and place, and the complete chart — Sun, Moon and Rising signs, every planet, the houses and a drawn wheel — is calculated instantly, free, with no account.

There is not even a server to send your birth data to: the calculator runs entirely in your web browser.

How It Stays Free

Because everything happens on your own device, running this site costs almost nothing — no uploads, no chart database, no accounts system. Occasional advertising keeps the lights on. That is the whole business model, and it means we never need to charge you at the results step.

Honest About Accuracy

Positions are computed from standard astronomical formulas in your browser. We say plainly — on the calculator itself — that a planet within about 3° of a sign boundary may fall in the neighbouring sign in some professional ephemerides. Astrology itself is a matter of personal belief and entertainment; see our Disclaimer.

Part of Loona Automation

Loona Astrology Tools is one of the free, problem-solving tools built by Loona Automation, founded by Aurang Zeb Loona, a school teacher and AI teacher trainer from Jaranwala, Faisalabad, Punjab, Pakistan. Loona's mission — Bolti Duniya — is that every book should speak, in every language, for everyone who cannot read. The same spirit runs through the whole family of tools: genuinely useful, free, and private by design.

Before You Write: Two Quick Answers

"Can you calculate or recover my chart for me?" We never receive your birth data — the calculator works only in your browser — so there is nothing for us to recover or recalculate. Open the calculator and enter your details again; it takes seconds.

"Please do not email us your birth details." For your own privacy, you never need to send your birth date, time or place to us — the tool needs them, we do not.

Response Time

Loona is a small, teacher-run project. We aim to reply within a few days; teaching hours come first, but every email is read.
privacy_inshort: In short: the birth details you type into the calculator are processed only inside your own browser, on your own device. They are never uploaded to us or anyone else — this page explains exactly what that means.
privacy_body:
The Short Version

Your birth data never leaves your device. Loona Astrology Tools works 100% locally in your web browser using JavaScript. We have no server that receives your birth date, birth time or birth place, and we could not see your chart even if we wanted to.

What Happens to Your Birth Details

  • Your birth date, time, city, latitude, longitude and UTC offset are read only by the calculator code running in your browser tab, only to compute your chart.
  • They are not stored — not in local storage, not in cookies, not anywhere. When you close the tab, they are gone.
  • They are never transmitted to us or to any third party. The astronomy and city files the page loads contain no information about you.

Analytics and Advertising Cookies

Like most free websites, this site uses standard third-party services that set cookies and measure page usage in aggregate:

  • Google Analytics — counts visits and shows us which pages are popular, so we can improve them.
  • Microsoft Clarity — shows us anonymous, aggregated usage patterns (such as clicks and scrolls) so we can fix confusing layouts. Clarity is configured to mask form-field text; even so, see the note below.
  • Google AdSense — displays advertisements that keep this site free; Google may use cookies, including DoubleClick cookies, to personalise ads based on your visits to this and other websites.

Important: these services measure page usage — they do not receive the birth data you type, because that data never leaves your browser. Analytics events from this site contain page information only, never your form entries.

You can block or clear cookies at any time in your browser settings; the calculator will still work.

Your Choices

If you contact us by email, we receive your email address and message solely to reply. We do not sell personal information. To ask anything about this policy, write to loonaautomation@gmail.com.

Last updated: 17 November 2026.

terms_body:
Using the Calculator

Loona Astrology Tools is free for personal use: calculating and reading your own birth chart, or a chart for someone who has asked you to. No account is required, and no part of the result is paywalled. You agree not to use the site for unlawful purposes.

Your Data

Everything you type belongs to you. Because the calculator works entirely in your browser, we never receive, store or claim any rights over your birth details or your chart. Nothing is saved: if you want to keep a result, use the Copy Summary button or note it down — closing the page discards it, and we cannot restore it.

Provided As-Is

The site is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. Planetary positions are calculated in your browser with a compact astronomy method and may differ from a professional ephemeris — a planet within about 3° of a sign boundary may fall in the neighbouring sign in some professional ephemerides. Astrological interpretations, where offered, are for entertainment and personal reflection only — see our Disclaimer.

Changes

We may improve the calculator and update these terms; the current version will always be on this page. Questions: loonaautomation@gmail.com.

Last updated: 17 November 2026.
disclaimer_inshort: In short: Loona Astrology Tools provides a free birth chart calculator for information and entertainment only. A birth chart is not scientific or professional advice, and no chart can predict events or outcomes in your life.
disclaimer_body:
Entertainment and Information Only

The calculator and any astrological content on this site are provided for general information, personal reflection and entertainment. Astrology is not a science, and nothing on this site is medical, psychological, financial, legal or any other kind of professional advice. For decisions that matter, rely on qualified professionals and your own judgement.

Accuracy of Positions

Positions are calculated in your browser with a compact astronomy method. A planet within about 3° of a sign boundary may fall in the neighbouring sign in some professional ephemerides. Houses use the Equal House system and are labelled as such; they are not Placidus houses.

Your Birth Time Matters

The Rising sign, Midheaven and houses change quickly through the day. If your birth time is approximate or unknown, treat those parts of the chart as approximate too — the calculator says so on the results when the time is unknown.

Corrections

We work to keep every page correct and working, but we cannot guarantee that every page is error-free on every device. If you find a mistake, please tell us via the Feedback page or at loonaautomation@gmail.com.

feedback_body:
How to Send Feedback

There is no form on this page — a form that collects your words and sends them nowhere helps nobody. Write to us directly instead: Email us your feedback

What to Include in an Error Report

  1. The page name — for example, "Birth Chart Calculator".
  2. What happened — the birth details you entered (date, time, city — only if you are comfortable sharing them), what you expected, and what the page showed instead.
  3. Your device and browser — for example, "Android phone, Chrome" or "Windows laptop, Edge".

What happens next: we check every report against the live site. If we find an error, we fix it and the correction goes live for everyone. Feature requests and new-tool ideas are welcome too — many Loona tools exist because a visitor asked.
howwework_title: How We Work | Loona Astrology Tools
howwework_inshort: In short: Loona Astrology Tools runs entirely in your browser. The birth data you type is processed on your own device and never leaves it — no account, no upload, no cost.
howwework_body:
Your Birth Data Never Leaves Your Device

This is the most important thing about how we work. When you enter your birth date, time and place into the calculator, that information is handled only by your own browser, on your own phone or computer. It is never sent to Loona, never stored on a server, and never seen by us. Nothing is saved at all — when you close the page, nothing of yours stays behind, because it never reached us in the first place.

How the Astronomy Works

The calculator converts your local birth time to UTC with the offset you provide, then computes the longitudes of the Sun, Moon and planets, plus the Ascendant and Midheaven for your coordinates, from standard astronomical formulas (a low-precision method in the tradition of Paul Schlyter's planetary-position calculations). Houses are Equal House. Expected accuracy and the cusp warning are stated openly on the calculator.

No Account, No Tricks

There is no sign-up and no login, and the full chart is simply free — the same promise at the start as at the results.

Free as Part of a Bigger Family

This site is part of the Loona Automation network of free tools in 40 languages. Every Loona tool follows the same rules: it runs in the visitor's browser, entered data stays on the device, and it is free. Loona Astrology Tools is built by Aurang Zeb Loona (Loona Automation), a school teacher and AI teacher trainer in Pakistan. His mission, "Bolti Duniya", is that useful technology should be free and within everyone's reach.
